name: Aurelius Technologies Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为董事会委员会成员变动、股息除权及季度业绩发布，未披露业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减、出售或新合约事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收141,461,401.0 MYR，同比-13.2%；净利润11,262,371.0 MYR，同比-31.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered changes in board committee memberships, dividend book closures, and quarterly results releases, with no disclosed expansion, new business, reduction, disposal, or new contract for any business segment. Latest quarter (2026-06-30) revenue was MYR 141,461,401.0, down 13.2% YoY; net profit was MYR 11,262,371.0, down 31.2% YoY.
